correctness.rationale: The classical Hesse pencil supplies nine flexes, twelve lines, nine quadruple points, and twelve double vertices in every characteristic greater than three. The flex torsor has affine Frobenius with Weil-pairing determinant q modulo three. Normalization minus its 60 branches plus 21 singular points gives the explicit zeta identity. Exhaustive, standalone exact enumeration of all 432 affine maps verifies ten full spectra, their 216/216 determinant balance, and nine distinct zeta signatures. A separate eigenline/quotient proof establishes the sharp point-free criterion. Exact q=7 cubic and Hessian calculations independently check explicit examples; no finite sample is used to infer a general theorem.
